Fixture provenance
==================

matches_real_sample.csv
  Built once from the commit-pinned dataset file (research.md R1) with:

    curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xgabora/Club-Football-Match-Data/25882a58a736daf7ece3781940eac17ae1117a66/data/Matches.csv \
      | awk 'NR==1 || (NR>=2 && NR<=11) || NR==64347 || NR==73508 || NR==112582 || NR==174503 || NR==192326 || NR==230559' \
      > tests/fixtures/matches_real_sample.csv

  Source file line numbers: 1 (header), 2-11 (first ten records), 64347 ("Ajax "),
  73508 ("Colon Santa FE"), 112582 (missing result), 174503 ("King\u0092s Lynn"),
  192326 ("Colon Santa Fe"), 230559 (the empty line).

  Dataset: Gabor, A. (2025). Club Football Match Data.
  https://github.com/xgabora/Club-Football-Match-Data
  Licence: MIT. The rows are reproduced unchanged under that licence.

All other files in this directory are synthetic: hand-designed rows that use the same 48-column
header as the real file (matches_edge_cases.expected.json records the expected outcome of every
row of matches_edge_cases.csv, keyed by 1-based source_row_number).

matches_contract.csv (feature 002) is synthetic: 23 rows with the real 48-column header, one row per
data-contract rule or edge case (valid boundaries, each rule violated alone, a two-rule row,
precedence against the per-column checks, duplicates, an orphan league/team for the convergence
tests). matches_contract.expected.json (contract version 1) and matches_contract.pre.expected.json
(version 0, feature-001 rules only) record the expected outcome of every row, keyed by the 1-based
source_row_number; each value is "loaded" or {"reason", "detail"}.
